X.note: Good 3D terrain map (looks like San Francisco Bay) with sticker-style icons for a coin, a document, a ship and a crane, and a clean gradient caption bar. The icons are small and unlabeled, and nothing links them to the 'factors' in the caption. The caption text is a medium size and the source line is small and dim. The summary idea comes through only weakly.

Y.note: This is a plain dark-mode checklist card on a blurred background, so it reads like a PowerPoint slide. The hierarchy is clear (orange kicker, white heading, grey subtext). The sub-lines are small and low-contrast for a phone, and the bottom third of the card is empty. The background is a blurred, unreadable building, so the frame has no visual interest.

why: X has real spatial and visual richness and a readable caption, while Y is a flat text slide with small grey body text and dead space.
top_fix_for_weaker: Replace the static card with a motion build. Show the three locks as large labeled icons or isometric building models, with the key numbers (4 stories, 5 homes) as big callouts. Raise the body text to at least 36px with higher contrast, and fill or shrink the empty lower half of the card.
